title: Bolt Graphics powers on its first Zeus GPU
excerpt: Bolt Graphics reaches a key milestone by successfully running its simulation-focused Zeus GPU for the first time.
body_html:
Bolt Graphics has reached a major milestone in the development of its simulation-focused hardware. The company announced that it has successfully powered on and tested its very first Zeus GPU.

The organization has spent a considerable amount of time working on the Zeus graphics processing unit, which is specifically designed for simulation tasks. This initial successful test run marks a significant step forward for the hardware project.
